page.layout: One page of running text in a single main column; marginal notes in the left margin (Varnefrid, Speed in Histor. Anglica, Senang, Gallia, P. Aemilius in Hist. Walt.) and a few right-margin fragments. Running head at top, page number at top centre.

main_text.p: In ITALIA apud LONGOBARDOS Varnefrid l. 5. H. L. & 6.27.4d37.Grimo- aldus, post quam in Foro Popilii ingentem ibrapam edidiffet, Opitergio deftructo, eorum finct Fruo- julianus Tarvisianusque divififfet cum pofi vetus fectionem arcum tenderet, vena bracchii rupta & medicis venena fupponentibus, mortuus, fuccef- forem Pertharitum habuit. Hic in oftavam usque annum, aflumptis regni confortium Ciimberto F. pacifice rem adminiftravit. Poft Ieme ab Alachi, Tridentinorum Duce rebellè rurfu- tum, qui tamen paulo poft, agente Cuniberto, in gratiam receptus, & Brixiane civitati prefecit. EXARCHUM Theodorus Carbonya adhuc agebat.

Speed in Histor. Anglica.In BRITANNIA praefuere CANTIANIS poft Egbertum Lothetus Egberti Fater, OCCI- DENTALIBVS Saxonibus preft Kenwaldinus * Erthwinus & † Kenwinus, Kenwaldi Fr. ORIENT TALIBVS adhuc Sigeric & Sibba fratres, NOR- THUMBRIS * Egfridus, cui, a Pictis fugam lantibus in angustias delato & ... † Alfridus, Oswii nothus : Maluce * Ariel redus, Penda F. ORIENTALIBUS Anglis † Eol- woldus, Ethelheri F.

Senang 1A?. Gallia. P. Aemilius in Hist. Walt.In GALLIA, post mortem Clotharii, Childericus, Auftrafiae Rex in Francia vocatus cit, Ebroinus, Palatii Magister, veritus ne abiecto rege moveretur, Theodoricum, natu minorem, fra- trem, coronari fecit. Galli Ebroini fuperbiam ferre non valentes, Ebroinum, & Theodonem monafterio includerunt. Childericus post quam bienno regno praefuit, a Amelis, nobili Franco, quem virgis caedi jussit, in Amelis fuit interfectus.

page.notes: Marginal and running text is partly obscured by show-through and heavy damage on the right half; many words in the right-hand column and the notes are doubtful and not fully legible. Several words are marked illegible or uncertain where the scan does not allow reading.
